Is there anything else a beginner needs to get started?

Just a few practical things and you'll be set:



A steel measuring tape - measure width first, then height, to the nearest 1/8". Never round up.


Decide inside vs. outside mount - inside mount sits within the window frame (cleaner look), outside mount covers the frame (better light block).


Basic tools for install - a screwdriver or drill, and a level. Most installs take 10-15 minutes with included brackets and hardware.

How do I use it properly the very first time?

Good question! Using cordless shades for the first time is simple once you know the trick:



To raise: lift the bottom rail straight up with your hand, slowly and evenly. Stop wherever you want, and it holds in place.


To lower: pull the bottom rail down at a slight angle toward you, then release gently.


Key tip: always guide the rail with both hands, one on each end. Pulling from the center or tugging quickly can make it bind or tilt.


For cordless blinds with slats, use the wand or tilt mechanism to open and close the slats rather than forcing them by hand.



Give it a slow, even pull the first couple of times and it'll settle in nicely.
